text: Into Your hand I commit my spirit; You have redeemed me, O LORD, the God of truth and faithfulness.
And You have not given me into the hand of the enemy; You have set my feet in a broad place.
For I have heard the slander and whispering of many, Terror is on every side; While they schemed together against me, They plotted to take away my life.
Let the lying lips be mute, Which speak insolently and arrogantly against the [consistently] righteous With pride and contempt.
As for me, I said in my alarm, "I am cut off from Your eyes." Nevertheless You heard the voice of my supplications (specific requests) When I cried to You [for help].
Be strong and let your hearts take courage, All you who wait for and confidently expect the LORD.
